能不能换台电脑恢复: whether it can be restored on another PC
所有备份（云端上传、本机导出）都会加密，用的是 AES-256-GCM + Ar: Every backup (cloud upload or local export) is encrypted with AES-256-GCM + Argon2id. The only difference is which key is used, and that decides whether it can be restored on another PC:
设了备份密码：用密码加密。任何一台电脑填上同一个密码就能恢复 —— 换机、重装系: Set: the file is encrypted with that password and can be restored on any computer with the same password — this is what makes reinstalling or switching machines work. Lose the password and nobody can open it; there is no backdoor.
只有这台电脑、这个 Windows 用户: only this PC and this Windows user
没设：用 Windows 账户加密（DPAPI）。数据不会明文落盘，但 只有这台: Not set: Windows account encryption (DPAPI) is used. Nothing is stored in plain text, but only this PC and this Windows user can decrypt it, so it cannot be restored on another machine.

全部设置外观 · 横条上的引擎与排序 · 自定义引擎及其地址 · 你换过的自定义: All appearance settings · the engines on the bar and their order · custom engines and their addresses · your custom icons · the whole favorites tree (folders, text, images, notes) · OCR API keys and secrets · the GitHub personal access token · WebDAV server, user and password · the favorites shortcut · favorites panel sizes. Built-in engine icons travel with the app and need no backup. Credentials are exactly the ones you entered here, so nothing must be re-entered after a restore — provided the backup used a backup password (see the card above), otherwise another PC cannot decrypt it. Window sizes are per-machine preferences (a large window may not fit a small laptop), so they are not backed up and defaults are chosen for the new machine.

「液态玻璃」横条样式的折射 / 色差由 WebView2 里的 WebGL2 着: The refraction and aberration of the liquid glass style are rendered in real time by a WebGL2 shader inside WebView2, using the actual desktop behind the bar. WebGL2 is required; without it the bar falls back to frosted and everything still works. With Live refraction on, the bar is hidden from screen capture (it does not appear in screenshots or recordings) — that is the price of flicker-free continuous refresh; turn it off to be captured again.
